subject: Intro: Nimbus Systems reseller + integration proposal
messages:
From: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@nimbus.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 01 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus reseller + integration proposal

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking a call earlier — great to meet. Nimbus helps ISVs embed LLM-powered search and automation into their app via a lightweight SDK and a partner-led resale channel. We’ve had a lot of success bundling in analytics and managed integration for mid-market SaaS teams.

We’d love to propose a joint reseller + referral arrangement where Nimbus sells Redwood-hosted bundles to their ISV customers and also supports co-marketing for integration projects. High level asks from our side:
- Commission ladder for referrals and resold subscriptions (we typically do 15-30% depending on ARR and TCV).
- Lead registration so Nimbus gets credit on early-stage leads they hand off to Redwood.
- A short onboarding window (30–45 days) and a technical enablement pack for our integration engineers.

I’ve attached a short term sheet and a matrix of our typical deals. Can you share what Redwood’s standard reseller economics look like and any partner agreement template you use? If it helps, we can run an internal pricing example for a 100-seat ISV bundle.

—Claire
Claire Diaz
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
partners@nimbus.io

Attachment: ISV_Partner_TermSheet_v1.pdf (summary of Nimbus program)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@nimbus.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 01 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus reseller + integration proposal

Claire — thanks for the note and the deck. Really interesting fit. I’ve looped Marissa (partner ops) and Sergio (channel sales) to tee up numbers and operational details. Quick answers up front:

1) Commission structure: Redwood typically has a three-tier approach — 12% referral credit, 18% standard reseller commission, and up to 28% for strategic deals with committed TCV/volume. We’re open to aligning on Nimbus’ ladder and adding accelerators for multi-year deals.

2) Lead registration: yes, we can do first-touch registration with a 90-day exclusivity window, plus a joint qualification step. We’ll want Nimbus to supply a signed MQL form (I attached our template below) and a copy of the lead activity.

3) Enablement & onboarding: we can commit a partner technical pack (integration spec, SDK playbook, 2 enablement sessions) and 30-day onboarding for pilot customers — can extend to 45 days for larger pilots.

I’ve attached an initial Redwood partner term sheet for your review and a link to the HubSpot deal so we can start tracking. If this looks broadly aligned, can we get a short call next week to walk pricing on a 100-seat example?

Best,
Ben
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Partner_TermSheet_Draft.pdf
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 01 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus reseller + integration proposal

Ben / Sergio — forwarding for partner ops POV. Quick notes:
- If Nimbus expects 15–30% by default we need to protect net revenue; propose stitching in a performance cliff: initial 18% for year 1 on committed ARR, then review against NRR/retention before accelerating.
- Lead registration: 90 days is ok but must include a lockout clause if Nimbus submits the same account to multiple partners. Require the signed MQL + a partner intake form (I can attach template).
- Co-sell vs pure reseller: important to define where Nimbus owns the first 12 months of support vs where Redwood remains primary. Suggest we delineate in SOW.

Also flagging DocuSign clause updates: need to add our standard audit and data residency addendum for any deals that include private deployment.

Marissa
Director, Partner Operations
Marissa Cole

Attachment: Partner_Intake_Form.docx (partner intake template)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@nimbus.io>
Date: Fri, Apr 02 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus reseller + integration proposal

Looping Claire back in. Two commercial points I want to lock down before we move to legal:
1) Minimum commit / MDF: For a reseller relationship at the 25% band we should require a TCV threshold of $150k or marketing development funds (MDF) equivalent. For referral-only (no MDF) we cap at 15% unless the account converts to a strategic deal.
2) Exclusivity & lead overlap: Accept 90-day registration but require evidence of first outreach; if Nimbus shows overlap with another partner we’ll default to joint credit split unless Nimbus provides proof of sole origination.

Claire — can you confirm Nimbus’ appetite for a minimum TCV or MDF? If yes, we’ll push these numbers into the term sheet and tee up legal reviews.

—Sergio
VP, Channel Sales
From: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@nimbus.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 02 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus reseller + integration proposal

Sergio — thanks for the clarity. Nimbus is comfortable with a $150k TCV threshold for the higher commission tier; we prefer not to set MDF up-front but can commit to joint marketing milestones tied to accelerators. For lead origination we can provide CRM export and a signed intake form for claims.

Next step for us: review updated Redwood term sheet with the TCV threshold and lead registration language, then route to our counsel for a quick review. I’ll also send a short technical kickoff including our Integration Spec (attached).

Talk next week — happy to join a pricing walkthrough.

—Claire

Attachment: Nimbus_Integration_Spec.xlsx
